requirement: Describe IMPACT as an international multicenter prospective observational cohort study conducted in routine care; do not describe premedication as randomized treatment.

evidence.text: international, multicentre, prospective, cohort study ... conducted during the clinical routine

notes: Birth-month sampling at centers is not treatment randomization.

requirement: Define the primary outcome as preoperative anxiety measured by APAIS at arrival in the operating room before induction of anesthesia.

evidence.text: preoperative anxiety measured with the APAIS ... at arrival in the operating room before induction

notes: The exact score derivation is a separate unresolved requirement.

requirement: Report the planned total of 4,000 participants and preserve the calculation chain: 207 for the overall effect, 3,312 for interaction detection, 3,680 after 10% dropout, rounded operationally to 4,000.

evidence.text: 207 patients ... 3312 patients ... dropout rate of 10% ... 3680 ... total sample size of 4000

notes: Do not present the illustrative unpaired t-test as the final primary analysis model.

requirement: Include all enrolled participants in the main analysis, while identifying any later operational exclusions as needing confirmation.

evidence.text: All patients enrolled in this study will be analysed.

notes: The source does not define a randomized ITT set because treatment is observed rather than assigned.

requirement: Use the protocol-specified multivariable ANCOVA for change in APAIS, comparing premedication exposure groups and adjusting for age, center, sex, ASA score, Charlson Comorbidity Index, and baseline APAIS.

evidence.text: multivariable analysis of covariance considering ... age, centre, sex, ASA score, Charlson ... APAIS score at baseline

notes: The later reference TSAP replaces ANCOVA with a mixed model; protocol-only systems must not guess that hidden revision.

requirement: Define the exposure contrast as participants receiving premedication versus those not receiving premedication, without implying randomized assignment.

evidence.text: differences between the patients receiving premedication or without premedication

notes: The CRF records actual exposure and drug details at Visit 1.

requirement: Include premedication-by-baseline-characteristic interaction terms and perform subgroup analyses when interactions are significant; report estimates with 95% confidence intervals.

evidence.text: significant interaction terms ... subgroup analysis ... parameter estimates and corresponding 95% confidence intervals

notes: The source does not fully operationalize multiplicity for these interaction tests.

requirement: Use multiple imputation for missing data and include sensitivity analyses assessing robustness.

evidence.text: In case of missing data multiple imputation will be used as well as different sensitivity analyses

notes: The imputation model, number of imputations, and MNAR strategy remain insufficiently specified in the protocol.

requirement: Analyze binary secondary outcomes using multivariable logistic regression and keep them secondary.
acceptable_values: multivariable logistic regression for binary secondary outcomes

evidence.text: Binary outcomes will be analysed by multivariable logistic regression model.

notes: Continuous secondary outcomes may use methods similar to the primary analysis as stated by the protocol.

requirement: Preserve the main visit anchors: baseline within 30 days before surgery, operating-room Visit 1 before induction, postoperative day-1 follow-up, and day-30 Visit 4 by telephone or ward visit plus database review.

evidence.text: within 30 days prior to surgery ... arrival into the operating room ... First postoperative day ... 30th postoperative day

notes: The protocol numbering skips from Visit 3 to Visit 4 in the displayed sections; preserve source labels.

requirement: State that formal AE/SAE definition and reporting are not required for this observational study; summarize only the predefined non-study-related complications collected at Visits 1, 2, and 4.

evidence.text: too remote to require their definition ... There will only be an assessment of predefined not-study related complications

notes: A generic drug-trial safety chapter would be inappropriate.

requirement: Use CRF Visit 1 fields to identify whether premedication was received and, when yes, its route, agent, dose, location, and timing.

evidence.text: Did the patient receive any premedication? ... which premedication ... Where and when

notes: This requirement is specific to protocol_crf and confirmed_decisions tracks.

requirement: Recognize that APAIS is collected at both baseline Visit 0 and primary-outcome Visit 1, and distinguish the two timepoints in derivations.
notes: A model must not treat the two forms as duplicate records at the same timepoint.

requirement: Map CRF baseline fields to the protocol covariates, including age, sex, ASA status, Charlson-related medical history, baseline APAIS, and number of previous surgeries.

evidence.text: Age ... Sex ... ASA ... Charlson Comorbidity Index ... Number of previous surgeries ... APAIS

notes: Center comes from study/site metadata rather than the participant CRF pages cited here.

acceptable_values: specific question covering item set, incomplete items, and change direction
